caseName: Kearney v. N.Y. Dep't of Corr. Servs.
caseNameFull: Richard KEARNEY v. NEW YORK DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONAL SERVICES

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
